g.text: Does fitting the actual stimulus set improve prediction?
5 repeated 70/30 splits. Dots: medians; whiskers: observed minimum–maximum, NOT confidence intervals.
Both families and fitting schemes use the same four-way finite prediction mask in each comparison.
